name: pulsating-button

frames.best_why: Both buttons carry a full, wide halo ring at once, showing the pulse at its peak.

tagline: Buttons breathe a soft ring of light outward in a slow repeating pulse.
summary: A pair of buttons that keep throwing a blurred halo outwards to pull the eye. One variant swells and shrinks the ring, the other sends it out and lets it fade.
appearance: Two rounded rectangles sit side by side on black: an indigo button with white text and a white button with dark text. Each is ringed by a soft halo wider than the button, tinted with its own colour.
behaviour: The halo spreads out from the button edge and fades, then repeats on a fixed duration, without stopping. The pulse variant grows and shrinks symmetrically, while the ripple variant pushes the ring out until it disappears.
demo_content: Buttons reading "Join the waitlist" and "Start free trial"
search_phrases: button with glowing pulse around it
looping glow to draw the eye
ripple ring spreading from button edge
use_when: One primary action must keep pulling the eye, such as a waitlist or launch signup.
avoid_when: Pages with several actions, or calm interfaces: the loop never stops and competes for attention.
customise: The label is passed as children; halo colour, duration, spread distance and the pulse or ripple variant are props, while size and base colours come from className.
weight_why: One CSS box-shadow keyframe on a decorative span, with no scripted animation loop.

a11y.note: The halo is hidden from assistive tech, but the perpetual pulse ignores reduced-motion settings.

issues: The halo on the indigo button reads as a darker plaque behind it rather than a glow.
polish_why: Smooth, well-paced halo and crisp labels; the shadow reads more as an outline than light.
